To My love,

Happy 6th anniversary, my love. Six years ago, our story began. And here we are, with so many memories behind us and so many more waiting to be made. Thank you for the laughter, the little moments, the patience, and the love we share. Thank you for being someone I can dream with, grow with, and look forward to tomorrow with. No matter where life takes us, I hope we keep finding reasons to smile, keep choosing each other, and keep making beautiful memories together. Six years down. A whole future to go. I love you, always.

With all my love, Your forever person
